scorer_notes: Marks from visual reading only, at 0.25 m/px. The imagery is soft (about 0.5 m source), so small openings and steps are at the limit of what can be seen. No stair could be resolved with confidence in any tile. Several marks are dark spots or shadows that could be pits, caves or vegetation, and they have low confidence. Linear dark lines on bare rock are marked as fissures; drainage gullies and footpaths are not marked. Ends are given as [[x1,y1],[x2,y2]] in pixels.
